input.quote: 14. INSURANCE. Throughout the term of this Agreement, Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 14 contains a usable insurance clause: workers' compensation as required by statute, CGL of USD 1,000,000, professional E&O of USD 1,000,000, and certificates/evidence of insurance on Company's request. It therefore already satisfies the fallback E&O element (USD 1,000,000) and several preferred elements. However, it contains no cyber/privacy coverage at all, and Contractor obtains Company Confidential Information ("all documents, software, reports, data, records, forms ... obtained by Contractor from Company") and may access Company computer systems and facilities under §1(c). The clause accordingly fails the fallback on the cyber element (USD 2,000,000), so we propose the single shortest addition at the fallback level. Shortfalls against the preferred position only (no CGL aggregate figure, E&O at USD 1,000,000 rather than USD 2,000,000, no post-term tail) are noted but not redlined.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.

mappings.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

proposal.summary: Add cyber/privacy liability coverage of USD 2,000,000 to the existing insurance clause
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Contractor handles Company data and accesses our systems and facilities, so we need cyber/privacy cover alongside the existing coverages. We have added the fallback USD 2,000,000 cyber and privacy limit; the existing E&O limit of USD 1,000,000 and certificates-on-request language are unchanged.

ops.text: Contractor shall also maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least two million dollars ($2,000,000).
